method: Rechecked the current manifest revision and the four 1991 source records by source_id, artifact SHA-256, Git blob OID, and paper_id. Their local upstream PDFs, byte hashes, blob identities, and page counts were verified in the preceding source-audit stage; this report does not repeat rendering or hashing.
Used the printed page-one titles extracted from the three text-bearing PDFs; the Shanghai PDF has no text layer, so its page-one title was visually inspected in the preceding stage.

Used the Hunan Provincial People's Government portal to corroborate that the 1991 '三南' pilot refers to Hunan, Yunnan, and Hainan. The article lists four subject groups and mathematics in groups 2–4, but does not establish whether this source PDF was the sole/shared mathematics paper across those groups.
